name: election/count-finished
note: The seal: a chained statement carrying the result, signed by ALL responsible counters named in the scope Seed. Closes the chain. The aggregator gate verifies chain-from-seed AND all-responsible-signed before counting this scope.

result.note: per-choice counted totals for this scope, as a JSON object {"<choice>": <count>, ...} (kton v0.4.0 has no tally type; the widget still shows a tally)

protocol.note: signed count-board protocol / tally sheet, by hash
